title: Tala Durith
subtitle: I Can Get You Inside
text:
Each other friendly unit gains Hidden.
Plot (When you deploy a leader, you may play this card from your resources, paying its cost. Replace it with the top card of your deck.)
rules: Hidden prevents a unit from being attacked during the same phase it enters play, so Tala Durith's ability means each other friendly unit can't be attacked the phase it enters play.
